diagnosis: VehicleStatusDirectUpdateView performs a bulk-style ORM update on CommercialFleetVehicle using .filter(id=vehicle_id).update(status=target_state). Because carrier_company is not included in the filter conditions, any authenticated logistics driver or dispatcher can alter operational statuses (e.g. marking vehicles as 'decommissioned' or 'in_maintenance') for fleet assets belonging to rival logistics carriers.
